spellbook.finance/limitations: Ending a listing cannot be undone from here. Publishing the copy again with spellbook_ebay_publish creates a new eBay listing, and the old one's watchers and view count do not carry over.
It touches eBay only. Each copy keeps its inventory status and bin, and a TCGplayer or ManaPool listing of the same copy stays live.
kept means the copy sits in a multi-copy variation listing, which stays live to protect the other copies. End it from eBay Seller Hub when the person wants all of them down.
no_listing means SpellBook holds no live eBay listing for that copy. Calling again for the same copy returns no_listing, so a repeat call ends nothing twice.
failed means eBay refused or timed out, and the listing stays live. The error field carries eBay's reason. Report it and retry only that copy.
It does not cancel an order. A buyer who already bought the card still expects it.

description: End the live eBay listings for up to 25 exact copies, and keep each copy in inventory so it can be published again. Take Item ids from spellbook_inventory_items_query. Show the person which cards will come down and get a yes before calling, because a live listing ends at once. Returns one result per copy: unpublished, kept, no_listing, or failed.

itemIds.description: Up to 25 exact Item ids whose eBay listings to end, from a prior spellbook_inventory_items_query. Required, at least one.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that owns the copies. Required.

name: spellbook_ebay_unpublish
